snippet.title: A Very Galley Christmas: Merry Christmas from Evil Trout Inc!
snippet.description:
Hi! 2025 was an amazing year for us at Evil Trout Inc. Our game, The Roottrees are Dead has been received unimaginably well. We created this little video Christmas card as a way to say thank you to our amazing fans and to tease our next game, The Incident at Galley House, (a remake of Type Help.)

The video was originally part of Adventure Game Hotspot's Developer Season’s Greetings Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=A9DVkC8P1Is
